trust_decision.summary: Request values written into the PHP source file DATAS/config.inc.php (later require_once'd on every request) are decided safe in File::updateConfigFile: non-password values are reduced to [a-zA-Z0-9._:-], then all values are addslashes()'d and single-quoted. The unauthenticated install route that feeds it is gated only by DbInstall::dbControl returning errorDbExist for the stored credentials.

landing_point.why: This is the only writer of config.inc.php ('EDITION DU FICHIER config.inc.php'). A grep for the file name in the summary leads straight to it and to its three callers.

fix_sites.entry_point: every HTTP request via Ctrl::initCtrl -> userAuthControl (login form, auth-token cookie, new 2FA params)
fix_sites.module_kind: core controller (authentication); feature change, not a config-file fix

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The config writer already filters every value at the pinned commit (app/Common/File.php:423-425). With no changed hunk to point at, a solver can reasonably call it already safe and stop.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: db_password is deliberately exempt from the character whitelist because a password may contain any character, including quotes. It must still round-trip exactly through config.inc.php so the install can connect to the DB. An over-broad fix that whitelists or strips the password breaks installs that use strong passwords.

O7_producer.where: app/Common/File.php:411-468 writes DATAS/config.inc.php; app/Common/Req.php:63-64 require_once's it on every request

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Widen the db_password-style exemption to another credential-like key (for example a key matching /pass/), or replace addslashes+single quote with double quotes, so a value reaches the define() line unfiltered.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The comment already explains an exemption for passwords because they 'may contain any character'. A maintainer adding SMTP or LDAP credentials to the config file would plausibly extend it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An admin settings route that writes another free-text value (such as a user limit or host label) into config.inc.php through updateConfigFile.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: limite_espace_disque is already persisted to the config file from this form. Adding limite_nb_users or similar alongside it is a natural extension.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A versioned update step that rewrites config.inc.php with a value read from the DB or from ap_agora settings (save/reload boundary).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: DbUpdate already edits config.inc.php during upgrades (paramsDelete). An upgrade that migrates a setting from DB to config would bypass request-level reasoning.

O9_family: code injection (CWE-94) into a generated PHP config file

O10_build.toolchain: PHP >=7.4 (app/Common/Req.php:288), no composer build for the app itself (vendored libs under app/misc)
O10_build.project_tests: none found (no tests/ or phpunit config outside vendored app/misc libraries)

j.j_sites_touched: app/Common/Ctrl.php, app/Common/CtrlObject.php, app/Common/Db.php, app/Common/DbUpdate.php, app/Common/File.php (time limits only), app/Common/MdlCategory.php, app/Common/MdlObject.php, app/Common/MdlObjectMenu.php, app/Common/MdlPerson.php, app/Common/Req.php (comment only), app/Common/Tool.php, app/Common/Txt.php, app/Common/VueHeaderMenu.php, app/Common/VueObjLogs.php, app/ModAgora/CtrlAgora.php (formatting/backup), app/ModCalendar/*, app/ModContact/CtrlContact.php, app/ModFile/*, app/ModForum/CtrlForum.php, app/ModOffline/*, app/ModSpace/MdlSpace.php, app/ModUser/*
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Apply the [a-zA-Z0-9._:-] whitelist to db_password too, or var_export every value. The first breaks legitimate passwords; neither matches anything in the published commit.

out_of_scope_notes: Req::isInstalling() skips initCtrl (authentication) for any offline action whose name contains 'install' (app/Common/Req.php:278-281, app/Common/Req.php:66). Today that only reaches actionInstall, but it is a broad substring gate.

actionInstall's 'already installed' gate depends on a live DB connection with the stored credentials (app/ModOffline/CtrlOffline.php:153, app/Common/DbInstall.php:32-37). If the DB is unreachable, the install form (and the config.inc.php rewrite) stays reachable without authentication.
The fix commit changes a SQL ORDER BY from Db::format() to a raw Ctrl::$agora->personsSort (fix.diff:1140-1141). That looks like it loosens SQL handling; it is not this advisory.
unverified: The published fix commit 92320bc is a full release bump (v26.9.8 -> v26.10.0: 2FA, CSS, translations; CHANGELOG fix.diff:1533-1541). None of its hunks touches File::updateConfigFile, its callers' values or actionInstall. The advisory's CWE-94/config.inc.php protection is not in this diff, so fix-commit attribution is likely wrong, or the real fix landed earlier. git history was not inspected (no shell used).

At the pinned commit I found no reachable path that puts a quote-breaking value into config.inc.php: non-password values are whitelisted, and the password is addslashes()'d inside a single-quoted literal (app/Common/File.php:423-425). The vulnerable version may predate this pin.
Latest release not provided, so present_in_latest could not be assessed.
